card.line: The Valley of Aijalon was a valley near Beth-horon, in land first given to the tribe of Dan. Joshua named it when he asked God to make the moon stand still.

moments.title: The moon stands still
moments.text: On the day the LORD gave the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua asked the sun to stand still over Gibeon and the moon over the Valley of Aijalon. The sun and moon stopped until Israel had defeated its enemies, because the LORD fought for Israel.
